prompt: What was the first-generation, four-speed manual transmission gearbox type of the Mazda R360 officially called in Japan?
answer: The four-speed manual version of the Mazda R360 was officially designated **KRBB** in Japan. (The two-speed “TORQ DRIVE” automatic version was designated **KRBC**.)
